item.title: Notion 2.51: AI Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search & more
item.description:
Leave the note-taking to us, with AI meeting notes

AI meeting notes is a new kind of block that perfectly captures and summarizes your conversations. And if you use Notion Calendar, you can have AI meeting notes added automatically to every meeting. Try it for free!

Find anything with enterprise search

Stop wasting time hunting for answers across your work tools with a new, unified search experience. Enterprise search looks across Notion and other tools for fast answers and quick summaries (not just links!).

Search across even more tools …

Now when you search, Notion AI will look across Microsoft (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive), with Gmail and Linear rolling out in the coming weeks and Zendesk, Salesforce, and Box in alphas soon! These new connectors join existing integrations to Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, and Jira. Available on the new Business Plan.

… and even PDFs!

All PDFs uploaded to your Notion workspace will be automatically searchable! This is a huge time-saver: No more manual parsing through PDFs for the information you need.

Research mode drafts detailed docs in minutes

Research mode saves days worth of time. It analyzes all of your sources (your workspace plus your connected tools)—and the web—to draft detailed, polished docs you can share with your team. Write project updates, research reports, and best-practices guides in minutes. Think of it as your personal analyst!

Welcome to your new AI Home

We’ve made it really easy to ask Notion AI a question, use research mode, or build a custom workflow. Just go to your sidebar and click the Home tab.

Chat directly with the latest AI models

No switching between apps or separate subscriptions: You can choose top models to chat with right in Notion. This is perfect for things like quick brainstorms when you don’t need context from your workspace. More models to come!

New plans with all-in-one AI pricing

We’ve simplified Notion’s pricing plans. The Business Plan & Enterprise Plan now include unlimited usage of Notion AI, including enterprise search, research mode, and AI meeting notes. You get all the best AI tools at the best price.

A long list of upgrades!

It’s not all AI. We also shipped several requests and quality-of-life updates. A mix of power meets simplicity!

Top teams love Notion AI

  • OpenAI, Engineering: “What used to take hours of debugging can now be solved in minutes just by asking Notion AI.” → Watch here

  • Ramp, CPO: “With Notion, every person at Ramp has an AI assistant.”

  • Harvey, CEO: “If you’re serious about operating as an AI-first team, Notion AI is a no-brainer.”

  • Planful, GTM Enablement: “Notion AI is like having an extra top performer on our team that’s always-on, tapping into our collective expertise to help reps find the best answers.”

item.title: Notion 2.50: Meet Notion Mail
item.description:
Our mission is to build beautiful tools for your life’s work. Last year, we launched Notion Calendar to help you better manage your most valuable resource—time. Now, we’re rethinking another daily tool that shapes our lives. Email.

Email hasn’t changed in decades! It’s noisy, tedious to manage, and definitely not beautiful.

With Notion Mail, your inbox thinks like you. It organizes itself, drafts your emails, and schedules meetings exactly how you would. It’s flexible (like Notion!) so you can make it your own.

Organize your inbox with AI

Tell Notion AI what types of emails are important to auto label, and it will sort them as they arrive. We’ve been testing auto-labeling with early users, and it’s a crowd favorite! This is a new AI feature that will get smarter over time, so please send us your feedback.


Stay focused with custom views

Split your inbox into custom views that show different focus areas. Sort your views by topic, urgency, sender, or any way you need to stay distraction-free.


Never write the same email twice

Use snippets to create email templates that you can reuse in a click. You can even include attachments and scheduling links! I have snippets for introductions, follow-up messages, and thank-you notes.


Schedule meetings instantly

We are finally putting an end to the back-and-forth of booking a meeting! Notion Calendar integrates with Notion Mail—just type /schedule, mark your availability, and let others pick a time. Get Notion Calendar free →


Write beautiful emails, faster

Just like Notion, you can type / to use your favorite content blocks! You can also prompt AI using your space bar. Use it to draft follow-up emails that use your Notion docs for context or just to polish your writing.

item.title: Notion 2.49: Page verification, Notion Forms with conditional logic, and more!
item.description:
Build trust with verified pages

Verified pages get priority in search results and show up in citations and mentions. We’ll remind you when it’s time to re-verify, so nothing ever gets stale.

Webhooks are here!

Send real-time updates to your API integrations whenever content changes in Notion. For example, use webhooks to publish Notion pages to your blog or automatically update your customer-experience team in Zendesk when a task is edited in Notion. Learn more →

Search Jira with Notion AI beta

Connect your Jira Cloud instance to quickly find answers about things like team priorities, status updates, and tasks. If the answer lives somewhere else (like Slack, Notion, or GitHub), Notion AI will find it!

View chart data in one click

Want to dig into the data behind a chart? Now you can click on any part of a chart to quickly learn about the details behind it.

Make better Forms using conditional logic

Notion Forms now allow you to ask follow-up questions based on earlier answers using conditional logic! This feature is available on Business and Enterprise plans, but anyone can try building and sharing a Notion Form →

View multiple databases on one page

Quickly toggle between databases (your project trackers, team docs, roadmaps—whatever you keep in Notion) without leaving your page. Just click Customize layout at the top of the page, select Tabbed under Page settings, and add your databases to the tabs below the heading.

Level up your admin controls

This one’s for workspace admins! Manage the settings of your members, guests, and security all in one place—even with multiple workspaces. If you’re on the Enterprise plan, simply head to Settings to set up your organization.

Sign in quickly and securely 💨

Quickly log in to Notion using passkeys like Touch ID or Microsoft ID. Plus, now you can use the same login credentials for Notion and Notion Calendar!

iCloud 🤝 Notion Calendar

This one’s for Apple users: Notion Calendar now works with iCloud Calendar! Download the latest Notion Calendar app here.

A few more improvements we made for you

  • For all our developers out there, our public API endpoints just got 2× faster.

  • Admins can now control which Notion workspaces employees can use on the company network. This helps keep work and personal accounts separate. Learn more →

item.title: Notion 2.48: Set up Notion in one click, Calendar updates, and more
item.description:
Let AI help you build

Create custom setups instantly with AI! Describe what you need (you can be as detailed as you’d like), and AI will build your use case. This is a huge timesaver. Just type /database and select Build with AI.

Workflows in one click

We made a bunch of pre-built setups for you, like Task Trackers, Meeting Notes, and Brainstorm Sessions. They're easy to customize, too. Just create a new page, click database, and select More templates.

Do more with recurring tasks

Automatically update pages on a schedule with recurring database automations. Set and forget tasks like weekly reminders, or auto-generate weekly status docs for projects marked as In Progress.

See who has access to your doc 👀

We made it really obvious who has access to your doc (and what type of access they have) in the Share menu so you never get a “need access” note again.

Limit what form respondents see

Now you can restrict viewing privileges so others in your workspace only see their own submissions—not the entire database of responses!

More reasons to replace your scheduling app

You can now set an expiration date for your scheduling link and how far into the future people can schedule a meeting with you in Notion Calendar. Download Notion Calendar →

More improvements to start the year!

  • If your automation has errors, we’ll now show you helpful tips so you can fix it!

  • We added the ability to search your settings from the ••• menu.

  • When you make a form that allows respondents to select more than one answer to a question, you can now limit the number of options people can select.

  • In the Android app’s inbox, you can now swipe left or right to act on notifications.

  • When you make a button, you can now set it to insert a block at the top or bottom of your page.

item.title: 2.47: More automations, answers from GitHub, and easy Calendar scheduling
item.description:
Get answers from GitHub Beta

Now when you ask Notion AI questions, it will search GitHub (in addition to other sources like Slack and Google Drive) to find answers. This is a big shortcut for finding code, markdown files, pull requests, and more. Learn more →

Automate 1,000+ workflows with webhook actions

We’ve been working hard to ship webhooks and this is our first big step. Now you can connect your workflows with thousands of other tools through platforms like Zapier and Make. Try the new automations in a button or database, like triggering a post to publish on X (aka Twitter) or updating a contact in Hubspot. So many possibilities! Learn more →

Press a button, send a notification

No more switching apps just to send a message to your team! Send a notification in Notion or a customized email from Gmail using a Notion button. Try it in your workflows to automatically notify coworkers when a bug report comes in, or email your manager when you’ve finished an important task. Learn more →

Easy scheduling with Notion Calendar

Another time-saver: Now when you Share availability in Notion Calendar, you can allow multiple people to book time with you, avoid conflicts, and handle reschedules—all without having to use a separate scheduling app. It’s super easy to add a scheduling link to your emails! Download Notion Calendar →

Capture notes with new iOS shortcuts

It’s now easier than ever to capture a quick idea! We’ve added four iOS shortcuts: create a page, search in Notion, add text to a page, or open a specific doc. Set them up by using the Shortcuts app on your iPhone. Download Notion on iOS →

Because details matter

  • Color Picker: We redesigned the color picker so you know exactly what element you’re changing.

  • Rounded Corner: We smoothed the corners of checkboxes in a database, ahh!

  • Happy Birthday: Try the Birthday event type in Notion Calendar. It automatically repeats every year so you never forget!

  • HIPAA AI upgrade: Did you know Notion AI is HIPAA compliant? And now HIPAA customers can analyze PDFs using Notion AI.

  • Monday.com importer Beta: Now you can import any kind of board from Monday.com. Select specific boards you want to bring into Notion or choose to migrate everything at once. Try the new importer →

item.title: Notion 2.46: Forms, Mail, layouts, new automations, and more!
item.description:
Watch the recap

Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

Introducing forms, right inside Notion!

Forms give you an easy way to capture requests, feedback, RSVPs, or anything you need right where you work. Responses are stored in a Notion database, where you can keep everything organized, visualize the input as a chart, or turn feedback into tasks. No need for an outside tool! You get unlimited forms for free. Try one out →

Notion Mail (coming soon!)

Email hasn’t changed in 20 years. It's cluttered, chaotic, and hard to manage. So we rebuilt it! Notion Mail is fast, minimal, and does all the organizing and back-and-forth of scheduling for you! Best part is “views” that let you customize your inbox to your workflows, just like the rest of Notion. We can’t wait for you to try the preview and hear how it changes the way you work. Join the waitlist!

Layouts to customize your page

The way you and your team work is unique and your tools should be flexible enough to match! So we created a way for you to layout your tasks, goals, documents, or whatever you keep in Notion. Your newly organized, beautiful pages will help keep teams focused and efficient. Try it out by hovering over any database page title and clicking Customize layout.

Automations can now send emails

Now you can use an automation to notify people via Gmail (one of your top requests!). Trigger an email when information changes, like when a form has been submitted or the status of a project changes. Soon you’ll be able to send custom web requests to platforms like Zapier and Make to trigger actions in other apps, too.

Automate more actions with formulas

This is a true superpower. Database and button automations now support formulas that can complete steps in the background when you trigger an action—a huge time saver. For example, when you mark a task done, you can automatically show how little time it took to complete. Dig in to learn more →

Introducing the new Marketplace

Have you created an amazing setup or workflow? We’ve made it easier than ever to list and sell your template. Native payments, analytics, reviews and ratings, safeguards to prevent unfair re-distribution—all in the best place for millions of users to discover your work! Whether you’re looking for the perfect template or starting a business—there are creators who make seven figures on Notion!—this is the place. Go to Notion Marketplace →

Custom emojis!

Maybe the best update ever? You can now upload your own emojis! Use them in your page titles or anywhere—just type /emoji or : followed by its name.

Personalize your URLs

Notion Site URLs often have a long string of numbers and characters, but now you can make them exactly what you’d like! Cory, our video producer and resident birder, turned his site birdingnyc.com/NYC-Birding-Checklist-3ebf732864 into birdingnyc.com/mybirds. Just use the Share → Publish menu. Learn more →

Shortcut to Notion features

When searching, type in a keyword like “Home,” “Settings,” or “Templates” to jump to specific places in Notion. Try it with the ⌘ P keyboard shortcut. It’s a small thing that can make you much faster!

A few more improvements

  • Load database info 15% faster. Even with all these new features, performance is still our top priority.

  • Now your page titles, database views, and database pages are aligned (check it out). Sometimes the smallest design details matter most!
